title: Baitfish Presence Before the Bite Window
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishfinder:reading baitfish_present=true
| bin _time span=30m
| stats count as baitfish_pings, avg(water_temp_c) as avg_temp by _time
| sort - _time
description: Shows when baitfish presence starts building before a better bite window.
value: A lead indicator is often more actionable than only logging the catch after the fact.
implementation: Track baitfish detections from sonar in `index=personal`; chart half-hour presence counts and water temperature.
visualization: Half-hour timeline of baitfish detections and water temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when baitfish start showing up before the stronger bite window, giving you an earlier clue to stay put or start fishing harder.
